people.name: Eunice Bledsoe
people.role: a stringer for the evening papers

secret.label: Murder
secret.description: Eunice Bledsoe is at the victim’s suite at the residential hotel from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM, alone with Friedrich Kreuzer when it happens at 8:00 PM.

coverSecret.label: Gambling debt
coverSecret.description: Eunice Bledsoe slips off to the El platform at Twenty-Third Street from 6:30 PM to 7:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

motive.description: blamed the victim for a ruin

secret.label: A child boarded out
secret.description: Lurline Dandridge goes to the back room at Mrs. Teague’s from 8:00 PM to 8:30 PM to see a child nobody is supposed to know about.

people.name: Emilio Marchetti
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim’s from the same block

secret.label: Fencing stolen goods
secret.description: Emilio Marchetti hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the newsstand on the corner from 9:30 PM.

secret.label: Fencing stolen goods
secret.description: Verity Thorndike hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the El platform at Twenty-Third Street from 9:30 PM to 10:00 PM.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Lucia Salerno slips off to the newsstand on the corner from 8:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

people.name: James Rafferty
people.role: the victim’s nephew, at loose ends

secret.label: Drinking in secret
secret.description: James Rafferty drinks alone at the back room at Mrs. Teague’s from 6:00 PM to 6:30 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

method.name: an ice pick

traces.description: the same two verses until somebody threw a shoe

Friedrich Kreuzer was found at the victim’s suite at the residential hotel. The tap was left running and the basin had overflowed a clean ring onto the boards. The drunk singing under the window came at 8:00 PM, and the singing stopped when the shoe came down, and that was the half hour. That puts the killing in that half hour and no later.
The coroner puts death between 6:30 PM and 8:00 PM — two hours of nothing useful. A single narrow puncture under the ribs. Very little blood outside the body.
